source.note: TCDB base and individual related-set checklists, consulted 2026-10-07; 438 cataloged cards across 13 Product Sets.

decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: Both physical series are combined into one #1-220 VCS Base checklist; all base cards have equal virtual availability. Silver Spotlight is its actual #1-118 collector checklist, excluding Series One checklist cards #119-120.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: Only the 22 numbered base cards in TCDB's Rookie Cards index receive an RC suffix. Insert rookie themes and parallel cards do not receive RC solely from their names.
decisions.subsetHandling: Checklist labels are cleaned of source CL shorthand. Toronto Raptors and Vancouver Grizzlies expansion-team cards carry Expansion in Subset; #209-218 carry Nuts & Bolts. The base #18 Mark Price has the source's two-team label.
decisions.teamReconciliation: Silver Spotlight #18 lists Washington Bullets where base #18 lists Washington Bullets / Cleveland Cavaliers; Silver Spotlight #91 lists Portland Trail Blazers where base #91 lists Detroit Pistons. Each checklist's label is preserved. Four base checklist cards have no team by design.
decisions.packFormat: Four cards per VCS virtual pack and 36 virtual packs per box. Verified odds from their original Series One or Series Two packs are stored at ProductSet level; the combined VCS pack flattens series and cannot represent the Metal Force retail-only channel.
decisions.unknownOdds: Jumbo, Rookie Roll Call, and Rookie Roll Call Silver Spotlight have no supported numeric pack odds, so oddsPerPack is null; those cards are cataloged but do not enter the virtual hit pool until odds are verified.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product unreleased with pack/box art, all card images, and pricing pending.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: One equal-availability #1-220 collector checklist: 120 Series One and 100 Series Two cards, including four checklists and ten Nuts & Bolts subset cards. 22 individually verified true RC subjects.

productSets.name: Jumbo
productSets.notes: Three 5 x 7 oversized related cards. Pack insertion odds and channel are not stated in the source; cataloged with no configured hit odds.

productSets.name: Metal Force
productSets.notes: Inserted 1:54 Series Two retail packs; retail exclusivity cannot be represented by one universal VCS pack.

productSets.name: Rookie Roll Call
productSets.notes: Random Series One insert; a numeric insertion rate is not verified. The insert's rookie theme does not make these true rookie cards.

productSets.name: Rookie Roll Call Silver Spotlight
productSets.notes: Ten-card Silver Spotlight companion to Rookie Roll Call; numeric insertion rate unverified.

productSets.name: Stackhouse's Scrapbook
productSets.notes: Only Metal-issued S-7 and S-8 of the cross-product ten-card set; inserted 1:24 Series Two packs.

productSets.name: Silver Spotlight
productSets.notes: 118-card Series One parallel #1-118; #119-120 are checklist cards without this parallel. Inserted one per Series One pack.
